t: Fairbanks borough mayor proposes temporary pause on large data center land use permits
b: Mayor Grier Hopkins proposed a temporary moratorium that would stop the borough from issuing land use permits for large data centers. Length and vote timing were not reported.
iw: A local permit pause would delay projects if adopted.

t: Petersburg Assembly begins drafting nine-month data center pause and zoning rules
b: The Assembly voted 6-0 twice, directing the borough manager to draft an ordinance for a nine-month pause on certain data center development and amendments to the zoning code. Both must return as ordinances and pass three readings.
iw: Proposed pause would block development if enacted, but not yet law.

t: Fairbanks borough lists data center moratorium among 2027 legislative priorities
b: The Assembly adopted its 2027 legislative priorities, which include asking for a moratorium on new commercial data centers until standards are set. It is a request to lawmakers rather than a local ordinance.
iw: Signals support for a pause, but it has no legal force.

t: Anchorage adopts first zoning rules for data centers
b: The Assembly voted 10-2 to define data centers as a land use, make them conditional uses outside residential zones, and require utility letters showing grid, water and wastewater capacity. Landscaping buffers and enclosed power equipment are also required.
iw: New review steps and capacity proof add cost, but projects remain allowed.
